summary: Simple one-POP renderer with built-in camera, basic transform, point light, optional texture map, internal Phong material, or external MAT. Use it for fast POP previews; use Geometry COMP plus Render TOP for full multi-geometry scenes.

key_params.name: ortho
key_params.note: Use orthographic projection instead of perspective.

key_params.name: normalizegeo
key_params.note: Translate and uniformly scale POP geometry to fit a size-2 origin box.

key_params.name: pop
key_params.note: Path to the single POP to render.

key_params.name: geoscale
key_params.note: Uniform scale for the rendered geometry.

key_params.name: lighttranslate
key_params.note: Position of the single point light.

key_params.name: colormap
key_params.note: Color Map TOP for internal Phong.

key_params.name: mat
key_params.note: External MAT when Material Source is MAT Node.

common_gotchas: The POP render/display flags are ignored, so explicitly set the POP parameter to the intended Null POP or output POP.
Background color is always premultiplied by alpha; set alpha to 1.0 for an opaque background.
Render Simple TOP is for a single POP preview; use Geometry COMP plus Render TOP for multi-geometry, multi-light, or multi-camera scenes.
Normalize Geo translates and uniformly scales geometry to fit a size-2 box at the origin, which can hide true world scale.
Use Info CHOP resx, resy, depth, and gpu_memory_used to confirm the preview target is at the intended TOP size and format.
